answer: Atlas commit-reveal bond: each locks a 70-credit bond, sealing an envelope in a public atlas — its work hashed, a fresh serial — before the lantern-lit reveal. At reveal it publishes; auditors recompute the hash, checking genuineness. A hollow envelope, empty or copied, fails and burns the bond. First fake costs 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 hollow envelopes cost 3,037,000, dwarfing any reward. An honest agent pays 40 once, bond reclaimed.
